extracted.intended_audience: members of the public with little or no patent knowledge (inventors, small businesses, entrepreneurs)
extracted.subtask_short: basic patent guidance for new applicants
extracted.subtask_description: A high-level, introductory guide to patents and the patent application lifecycle, covering what a patent is, how to apply, types of patents/applications, the examination and filing process, and post-grant management and enforcement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent essentials
rubrics_metrics.description: Here you’ll find what you need to know if you know nothing about patents. We’ll take you from “What is a patent?” to assistance with the application process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Basic questions about patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Section covering fundamental FAQs and introductory questions about patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foreign patents and treaties
rubrics_metrics.description: Information about patent protection in foreign jurisdictions and relevant international treaties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventor assistance
rubrics_metrics.description: Resources and assistance available specifically to inventors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Functions of the agency
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview of the USPTO’s roles and functions in the patent system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applying for patents
rubrics_metrics.description: This section dives into more detail about how you can apply for a patent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers legal representation, deadlines, fees, and other essential parts of the process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on searching existing patent literature and prior art.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attorneys and agents
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on patent attorneys and agents and how they can assist applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Explanation of the different patent types available (e.g., utility, design, plant).

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Discussion of different application routes and formats (e.g., provisional, nonprovisional, PCT).

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination process
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview of how patent applications are examined by the USPTO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ready to file
rubrics_metrics.description: Resources and checklist items to prepare before filing a patent application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Managing your patent
rubrics_metrics.description: Here we take you from being successfully granted a patent to maintaining your rights.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You’ll learn how to maintain, enforce, transfer, and protect your rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nature of rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Information describing what rights a patent grants to the owner.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent marking
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on marking products and publications to indicate patent protection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Term extensions
rubrics_metrics.description: Information about extensions to patent term (e.g., for regulatory delays).

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintenance fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Details on the fees and schedules required to keep a patent in force.

rubrics_metrics.name: Corrections
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for correcting errors in issued patents or pending applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ownership
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on ownership issues and how patent rights are attributed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assignments and licenses
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on transferring (assigning) and licensing patent rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Infringement
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview of patent infringement and enforcement options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Helpful resources for new customers
rubrics_metrics.description: Pointers to resources designed for first-time or new patent customers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access free patent services
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on how to access pro bono or free patent-related services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review online patent tools
rubrics_metrics.description: Links and descriptions of USPTO online tools for searching, filing, and managing patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overview of the patent process
rubrics_metrics.description: High-level walkthrough of the end-to-end patent process from idea to grant and beyond.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify if you have a patent
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance to help determine whether an invention or idea qualifies for patent protection or whether you already have rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: IP Identifier
rubrics_metrics.description: Tool/section to learn the type of intellectual property you have and how to protect it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Navigating the IP process
rubrics_metrics.description: Resources aimed at helping small businesses and entrepreneurs find appropriate IP-related assistance and next steps.
